overview: The MTNL Innovation Programme is a scheme under the PSU Support category aimed at fostering innovation within Mahanagar Telephone Nigam Limited (MTNL), a Government of India enterprise. The programme encourages innovation among employees and stakeholders through initiatives such as innovation challenges, idea submissions, and recognition of innovative projects. It aligns with MTNL's vision to become a total solution provider and global telecom company by promoting innovation in telecom and IT-related services.
objectives: Foster a culture of innovation within MTNL and its subsidiaries
Encourage employees to submit innovative ideas for telecom and IT services
Recognize and reward innovative contributions by employees and stakeholders
Support innovation in telecom services, IT services, and customer service delivery
Promote innovation in areas such as network optimization, customer service, and digital services
Encourage participation from employees across departments and levels
Recognize innovations that improve service quality, reduce costs, or enhance customer experience
Promote innovation in sustainability and green telecom initiatives
eligibility: Open to serving and retired employees of MTNL, employees of MTNL subsidiaries (such as MSITS Ltd.), officers on deputation to MTNL or its subsidiaries, and individuals associated with MTNL through deputation or contractual arrangements, subject to internal guidelines and approval by the Competent Authority.
benefits: Recognition through certificates, certificates of appreciation, certificates of merit, and potential monetary rewards or awards as per the Innovation Programme guidelines; opportunities to present innovations at MTNL forums; possible implementation of innovative ideas within MTNL operations; recognition in MTNL communications and internal platforms.
financial_support: Financial support, if any, is provided in the form of awards, honorariums, or grants for prototype development or pilot implementation, as per the Innovation Programme guidelines approved by the Competent Authority; specific quantum and mechanism are determined on a case-by-case basis.
application_process: 1. Monitor MTNL official website (www.mtnl.net.in) for innovation programme announcements. 2. Check notices such as 'Calling of Volunteers for ONE (01) Post of CEO on deputation to Mahanagar Telephone Mauritius Limited (MTML)' or similar innovation-related notices. 3. Prepare application or proposal as per the prescribed format in the notice. 4. Submit application through proper channel to the designated officer (e.g., GM(HR & Legal) or as specified in the notice). 5. Ensure submission before the deadline mentioned in the notice. 6. Await scrutiny by the screening committee. 7. Await approval by the Competent Authority (CMD, MTNL).
required_documents: Details of posts held and experience
Details of innovation or idea submitted
Supporting documents for the innovation (e.g., prototypes, reports, presentations)
Any other documents as specified in the innovation programme notice
deadlines: As per specific innovation programme notices (e.g., Extension of last date for submission of application for one post of Dy.Mgr(IT) at MTNL STPI IT Services (MSITS) Ltd. Chennai on deputation basis till 22.01.2026; Extension of last date for submitting application for one post of CEO MTML on deputation basis till 05.05.2026)
implementing_agency: Mahanagar Telephone Nigam Limited (MTNL), Corporate Office
contact_details: Email: gmhrco@bol.net.in (GM HR & CO), Phone: 011-24322522 (as per Citizen’s Charter), Email: mtnllegalcell@gmail.com (for legal/empanelment notices), Website: www.mtnl.net.in
caveats: Participation is subject to internal guidelines and approval by the Competent Authority (CMD, MTNL)
Innovations must be relevant to MTNL's business and service areas
Financial support, if any, is subject to availability of funds and approval
Applications must be submitted through proper channel and by the specified deadline
Innovations must not violate any existing policies, policies, or intellectual property rights
MTNL reserves the right to modify, cancel, or amend the Innovation Programme guidelines
